what_it_proves: createEmployee() rejects a request whose email already belongs to another employee with DuplicateEmployeeException, using a mocked EmployeeRepository. Fails on the pre-change code (which calls findByEmployeeNumber(email) and never matches), passes on the patched code (which calls findByEmail(email)).
mocking_strategy: Mockito-mock EmployeeRepository; stub findByEmail(...) to return a present Optional and assert the service throws DuplicateEmployeeException before save() is invoked.
